# Definition
**Rh Alloimmunization** is the process by which a mother is sensitized to Rh antigens that are not present in her blood. She hence develops antibodies to those antigens that will attack a baby with those antigens and cause fetal anemia.


>You’re worried if mom is Rh- and baby is Rh+, that if there is any fetomaternal bleed, then mother will develop antibodies against the Rh antigen.
